description: LSE Capital Limited is a corporate advisory house licensed by the SECP as a Consultant to the Issue, working on mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance and restructuring, and initial public offerings. It was founded by a group of value investors and capital-market practitioners, and describes itself as the parent entity of LSE Enterprises, overseeing three group companies that are successor entities of the former Lahore Stock Exchange.
headOffice: The Exchange Hub, LSE Plaza, 19 Kashmir Egerton Road, Lahore, Pakistan
